CO_T.description: Display Option Color - Thickness (CO_T). Per-thickness display colors: each key is a thickness id, and the fields set the wire-frame, hidden-fill, and hidden-edge RGB components plus the opacity (blending) option and factor.

W_R.description: Wire-frame color, red component (0-255). Combined with W_G and W_B into the wire-frame RGB color.

W_G.description: Wire-frame color, green component (0-255). Combined with W_R and W_B into the wire-frame RGB color.

W_B.description: Wire-frame color, blue component (0-255). Combined with W_R and W_G into the wire-frame RGB color.

HF_R.description: Hidden-fill color, red component (0-255). Combined with HF_G and HF_B into the hidden-fill RGB color.

HF_G.description: Hidden-fill color, green component (0-255). Combined with HF_R and HF_B into the hidden-fill RGB color.

HF_B.description: Hidden-fill color, blue component (0-255). Combined with HF_R and HF_G into the hidden-fill RGB color.

HE_R.description: Hidden-edge color, red component (0-255). Combined with HE_G and HE_B into the hidden-edge RGB color.

HE_G.description: Hidden-edge color, green component (0-255). Combined with HE_R and HE_B into the hidden-edge RGB color.

HE_B.description: Hidden-edge color, blue component (0-255). Combined with HE_R and HE_G into the hidden-edge RGB color.

bBLEMD.description: Opacity (blending) option. When true, the hidden-fill is rendered with the opacity factor FACT.

FACT.description: Opacity (blending) factor, meaningful when bBLEMD is true. Typically 0.0 (transparent) to 1.0 (opaque).
